Tiger Woods was seen hugging his children, Charlie and Sam, during the second day of practice at Augusta National Golf Club before The Masters 2015. His long-time girlfriend, skier Lindsey Vonn, was also there. Woods had been away from golf for 60 days to recover from minor injuries and get back into shape. This practice session was his first public appearance in that time.

Pep Guardiola says Jerome Boateng is one of the best central defenders in the world. He is dealing with many injuries before Wednesday’s German Cup quarter-final match against Bayer Leverkusen.

Bayern Munich has several players who cannot play. They are missing Arjen Robben, Franck Ribery, David Alaba, Javi Martinez, and Tom Starke. Bastian Schweinsteiger is also out. Guardiola said at a press conference that Schweinsteiger will not be ready in time.

Newcastle defender Daryl Janmaat said the team got exactly what they deserved when they lost 1-0 to Sunderland. The 25-year-old Dutch player played the entire 90 minutes, even though he hurt his calf muscle during warm-up. Despite his effort, Sunderland won the match. This loss was Newcastle’s fifth straight defeat in this rivalry. The team did not create any good chances on another bad day for manager John Carver’s squad. Janmaat was honest about how poorly the team performed.

Before the first major golf tournament of the year, everyone is talking about whether Rory McIlroy can win a career grand slam and how well Tiger Woods will do in his comeback. Sportsmail’s Derek Lawrenson will provide daily updates from inside Augusta.

The world’s number one player, Rory McIlroy, is shown protecting himself from the rain during a practice round.

Ian Poulter is also featured. The English golfer is very excited to drive down Magnolia Lane for the Masters, even after all these years. However, he made a mistake. When he got out of his car, he realized he had left his golf clubs at his rental house.

Per Mertesacker says that bringing back an "arguing culture" was key to improving Arsenal’s results after some heavy losses last season. The team had been beaten 6-3 by Manchester City and 5-1 by Liverpool, which caused them to drop from first place to fighting for a spot in the Champions League. Mertesacker, who was seen arguing with teammate Mesut Özil last season, admitted that losing to bigger teams embarrassed the players. This embarrassment motivated them to argue more, which helped turn things around.

The 79th Masters tournament starts on Thursday. Most attention will be on Rory McIlroy, who is trying to become only the sixth person in history to win all four major golf championships (a career Grand Slam).

Tiger Woods is also in the spotlight. He is playing in his first competitive tournament since February. He has dealt with many injuries and a problem with his short putting (chipping). He is hoping to win his fifth green jacket and his 15th major title.

Bubba Watson is the current champion. The other players include young American stars Jordan Spieth and Rickie Fowler, as well as many past winners like Phil Mickelson and Adam Scott.

Amir Khan and Adrien Broner have spoken to each other online, possibly through FaceTime, about fighting each other this summer. Khan is expected to announce his next opponent very soon. He might also fight his British rival, Kell Brook, at Wembley Stadium next year.

In a short video posted on Instagram, Broner told Khan, "Let's get this money," urging him to make the fight happen. Khan has not fought since he beat Devon Alexander in December, and he has had trouble finding an opponent. Meanwhile, Broner has been constantly challenging Khan to a fight ever since he easily defeated John Molina Jr.

Amir Khan has confirmed his next fight will be against Chris Algieri on May 30. This ends rumors about who he would face next.

Earlier this week, there was pressure for Khan to fight British rival Kell Brook, the IBF welterweight champion, in June. Khan was also linked with fights against Adrien Broner and Keith Thurman. However, Khan said he was already in advanced talks to fight someone else.

Khan’s last fight was in December against Devon Alexander, which he won. That victory brought his record to 30 wins and 3 losses.

People in Augusta say the azaleas are fully bloomed, but that is not true for England’s Justin Rose. Last month, he played poorly in Florida, and his ranking dropped out of the world’s top 10. This was a blow to his pride, especially since he has been in the top five for the last three years and the Masters tournament is coming up soon.

Rose’s form has been bad, with three missed cuts and a 55th-place finish at the Cadillac Championship in his last four PGA Tour events. To fix this, the 34-year-old has been practicing for many hours over the past two weeks.

Lionel Messi’s foot injury has healed, and he is expected to play in Sunday’s La Liga game against Celta Vigo. He missed Argentina’s recent friendly matches against El Salvador and Ecuador, but after returning to Barcelona on Thursday, he was able to do light running and stretching during practice. Messi is recovering faster than expected. The club’s website stated that the swelling in his foot has gone down and that he will try to join the rest of the team in training tomorrow.

Rory McIlroy says it is impossible to imagine that he will never win the Masters. He wants to win it to complete his career grand slam. He also said that his final-round collapse at Augusta National in 2011 was the most important day of his career. McIlroy is trying to win his first green jacket. If he wins, he will be only the sixth player to win all four major titles. The other five players are Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, and Tiger Woods. Floyd Mayweather Sr. is ignoring the criticism from Freddie Roach, Manny Pacquiao’s trainer. Roach has been attacking Floyd Sr. ahead of the big fight between Floyd Mayweather Jr. and Pacquiao in Las Vegas on May 2. Roach says Floyd Jr. would be better off having his uncle, Roger Mayweather, as his trainer instead of his father. Roach told Yahoo Sports that Roger is the better trainer and that Floyd Jr. won’t have his best support if his father is in his corner. Floyd Sr. has chosen not to respond to these comments.

Amanda filed for divorce on March 16, stating that the marriage had broken down beyond repair and that they were too different to live together. This comes after Dufner looked sad while struggling on the golf course last year due to a neck injury.

Bolasie has a chance to play well against Manchester City on Monday. His manager says it would take a huge amount of money to convince Palace to sell him. The manager wants the 25-year-old to keep improving his skills at Crystal Palace.

Reading, who reached the FA Cup semi-finals, are still worried about being relegated from the Championship. They played Cardiff at the Madejski Stadium and lost a 1-0 lead to end in a 1-1 draw.

Robbie Fowler, a former Liverpool player, says the team should focus on reaching the FA Cup semi-finals instead of worrying about Steven Gerrard. Gerrard is leaving Liverpool at the end of the season to join the LA Galaxy in Major League Soccer. He hopes to finish his time at the club by leading the team, managed by Brendan Rodgers, to the final at Wembley. However, before Wednesday’s quarter-final replay against Blackburn, Fowler warned Gerrard’s teammates not to focus on giving the 34-year-old a perfect ending to his career at Liverpool. Cairney jokes that he doesn’t know what Toure did with his shirt, suggesting Toure might have used it to clean his car. Now, Blackburn hopes to avoid another loss when they play Liverpool in the quarter-final replay on Wednesday.

London Broncos have signed 19-year-old Elliot Minchella from Leeds on a loan deal that lasts until the end of the season. Minchella plays as a loose forward. He has played six games for Leeds as a substitute, but he has not yet become a regular starter for them this year.

London’s coach, Andrew Henderson, said that Leeds recommended Minchella highly and that he was trained well. Henderson believes Minchella will improve the quality of London’s forwards and create more competition for playing spots.

Minchella and his teammate at Leeds, Zak Hardaker, are currently being investigated by Leeds for an assault.

Stuart McCall said on Sunday night that his best game as Rangers manager gave him "goosebumps" and made him believe he can lead the team back to the top league. The match ended with Rangers captain Lee McCulloch apologizing for a bad red card. However, goals from Kenny Miller and Haris Vuckic in the first half secured the win. This victory was important because it gave Rangers three points against Hearts, who won the second-tier league, even though McCulloch was sent off in the 44th minute.

Monaco finished fourth after drawing 0-0 with Montpellier at home on Tuesday. If Monaco had won, they would have had the same number of points as third-place Marseille. However, Monaco could not score against a well-organized Montpellier team, which is currently in seventh place. Early in the second half, Monaco’s striker Lucas Barrios missed a penalty by shooting over the crossbar. Substitute Dimitar Berbatov played in the match, but Monaco still ended with no goals. As a result, Monaco remains in fourth place, behind Marseille, Lyon, and Paris Saint-Germain.

Tottenham Hotspur goalkeeper Hugo Lloris will not play in Sunday’s Premier League match against Burnley because he is still healing from a cut on his knee. He got injured two weeks ago during a 4-3 win against Leicester City. He was taken off the field on a stretcher and missed friendly matches for France against Brazil and Denmark. Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino said on Thursday that Lloris is still recovering and will not play.

Blackburn Rovers manager Gary Bowyer wants his top scorer, Jordan Rhodes, to be the hero in the FA Cup. Blackburn, who are considered underdogs, are playing Liverpool at Ewood Park. This will be the first time the stadium is completely full since 2011.

At the start of the season, Hull City offered £12 million for Rhodes, but Blackburn refused to sell. If Rhodes, who has scored 17 goals, scores the winning goal in Wednesday’s replay, that decision will look like the right choice. It would also send Blackburn to Wembley.

Manchester City manager Manuel Pellegrini says his team must beat Crystal Palace to avoid falling further behind their rivals. City’s title hopes are fading. On Saturday, they watched helplessly as Chelsea extended their lead at the top of the Premier League. At the same time, Arsenal and Manchester United moved ahead of City, pushing them down to fourth place. This was not what City expected when they tied with Chelsea on New Year’s Day. If City drops further, the pressure on Pellegrini will increase significantly. He has warned that his team must overcome the difficult challenge of playing Crystal Palace.

Every week, Sportsmail’s reporters rate the players, and we pick the best starting team for the Premier League. This week, Eden Hazard, Mesut Ozil, and Joey Barton made the list because they played so well that they won “man of the match” and helped their teams win. Who else is on the team? Read on to find out.

Goalkeeper: Tim Howard (Everton vs. Southampton) – Score: 7. He had to be ready for James Ward-Prowse’s tricky shot. He stretched out his left hand to stop the ball. His performance was key to Everton’s win.

Defender: Antonio Valencia (Manchester United vs. Aston Villa) – Score: 7.5.

A study by Brown University in Rhode Island claims that playing video games helps people learn better than non-gamers. The research found that gaming improves the ability to learn various tasks more accurately and may even place gamers in an "expert" category for problem-solving. However, the researchers are not sure if gaming actually makes people learn skills better, or if people who are already good at learning are more likely to become gamers. The study suggests that video games may improve both visual task performance and the ability to learn those skills.

Neymar, a star player for Barcelona, believes that his team’s upcoming Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) will be an exciting show. He expects lots of action, especially since Barcelona recently beat Manchester City, the champions of the English Premier League, in the previous round. The two teams will play in Paris on April 15. Neymar told Samba Foot that the game will be great because it features two strong teams with excellent players, making it a true spectacle. The text also notes that Neymar was seen training with Barcelona on Saturday as they get ready to play Celta Vigo on Sunday.

Andros Townsend said he had thought a lot about his funny reply to Paul Merson. After scoring a great equalizing goal for England against Italy, Townsend used Twitter to respond to criticism from Merson, a former Arsenal and England player. Townsend said that as soon as his goal went in, he really wanted to send the tweet. He is waiting for Merson’s reply and has not seen it yet. The goal made the score 1-1 in a friendly match in Turin on Tuesday night. Townsend celebrated with his Tottenham teammates, Ryan Mason and Kyle Walker. This information comes from a column for Sky Sports.

Nearly two weeks after Liverpool’s poor loss to Manchester United at Anfield, it seems the team has already learned from the mistake. When asked about a setback that could prevent Brendan Rodgers and his players from qualifying for next season’s Champions League, midfielder Joe Allen expressed regret. Speaking to a young fan at the Melwood training ground, Allen said, “They were ready to go, and maybe we weren’t. Maybe the rivalry sometimes gets in the way.” This comment came after Allen competed against Ander Herrera during Liverpool’s Premier League defeat to Manchester United at Anfield. Allen also spoke with Sportsmail’s Ian Ladyman at the club’s training facility.

Mike Brown says he will take a careful approach to recovering from his latest concussion. The England full-back does not know when he will be able to play again. He recently withdrew from Harlequins’ match against Saracens at Wembley last weekend.

Other players have faced similar issues. George North, who plays for Northampton, was told by doctors not to play for the rest of the season after suffering four concussions in a short time. Also, Ireland’s Johnny Sexton was sidelined for 12 weeks earlier this season.

Brown wants to avoid a long break, so he will not rush back to play before he is ready.

In 1908, Jack Johnson beat Tommy Burns to become the world heavyweight boxing champion. This victory started a frantic search for a white boxer to defeat him. Today, Johnson’s win would not be surprising, but in America at the time, it caused great anger because Johnson was black. No black man had ever held this top sports title. Racism was widespread in America, and the idea that a black man could be better than white men was unacceptable. As boxing expert Bert Sugar said, this title belonged to white men, and it felt like a slave had become his master. Johnson was the first black world heavyweight champion.

Roberto Martinez will speak with Romelu Lukaku because his new agent, Mino Raiola, suggested the striker might leave Everton this summer. Raiola, who has handled big transfers for players like Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Mario Balotelli, said he would never have agreed to Lukaku’s £28 million move to Everton last year. This has made Lukaku’s future at the club uncertain, even though he is only in the first year of a five-year contract.

Lauren Hill, a 19-year-old basketball player with cancer, is spending her final days raising money for cancer research. She has already raised more than $1.5 million. Lauren uses a wheelchair and spends many hours sleeping at Children's Hospital in Cincinnati, where doctors are treating her for a brain tumor. She wants to help other people at the hospital while she continues to fight her illness. Lauren was diagnosed with DIPG (a rare type of brain cancer) during her senior year of high school. This disease has a survival rate of less than 10 percent. Her mother, Lisa, posts photos of Lauren online to track her progress.

First impressions are not always right. In 2008, during a Championship match against Nottinghamshire, Adam Lyth scored only 22 runs. Graeme Swann called him a “walking wicket,” meaning he was easy to get out. But Swann later said, “He proved us all wrong.”

Lyth hit back in that same match by scoring 132 runs in the second innings. Seven years later, Wisden called him “the find of the season.”

Now, Lyth is one of six players from Yorkshire who are part of the England team. They left Heathrow Airport on Thursday to play three Test matches in the Caribbean.

Manchester City’s chance to keep their Premier League title was hurt again when they lost 2-1 to Crystal Palace. Manuel Pellegrini’s team played poorly.

Glenn Murray scored for Crystal Palace in the 34th minute from close range. Then, Jason Puncheon scored a great free-kick to make it 2-0. Yaya Toure scored one goal for Manchester City, but it was not enough to win.

Because of this loss, Manchester City fell further behind Chelsea, who are currently leading the league. SportsMail’s Sami Mokbel explains the most important moments of the game.

Jason Puncheon, a midfielder for Crystal Palace, was hit by an object during his team's 2-1 victory over Manchester City. The object was a MAOAM candy. Puncheon, who scored the winning goal, was 28 years old. He was walking to take a corner kick in front of Manchester City’s traveling fans when he was hit by the flying candy in the second half. Afterward, Puncheon clapped toward the City fans and sarcastically gave them a thumbs-up.

Chris Jans, the basketball coach at Bowling Green University in Ohio, was fired after video showed him behaving badly while drunk at a local bar on March 21. The footage shows him touching an unidentified woman’s buttocks. Witnesses also said he grabbed another woman’s head, moved it toward his crotch, and called a third woman a bad word. A source said the situation got so intense that a woman slapped him before he was asked to leave.

Mesut Ozil will not be fined after being seen at a Berlin nightclub shortly after missing Arsenal’s game against Newcastle because he was sick. Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger spoke with Ozil about the incident and is happy with his explanation. Although Ozil missed the match due to a cold, his appearance at the club was surprising. However, Wenger stated that Ozil only went out for 30 minutes to celebrate a friend’s birthday, and he considers the matter resolved.

Harry Kane will play for England’s Under-21 team in this summer’s European Championships. He spoke with Gareth Southgate about this decision. England’s head coach, Roy Hodgson, confirmed that 21-year-old Kane will join the junior squad. He will do this after he returns from Tottenham’s post-season tour of Malaysia and Australia.

Kane had a strong start with the England team. He scored a goal in his first game against Lithuania at Wembley. He has also impressed people with his hard work and attitude. He made his first starting appearance for England in the match against Italy, after coming off the bench to score in the game against Lithuania.

Andros Townsend called Harry Kane the best goal-scorer he has ever played with. He also predicted that Kane will have a great career playing for England.

Kane played for England for the first time on Friday. He came on as a substitute against Lithuania and scored just 79 seconds after entering the game. Last night, Kane started a friendly match against Italy in Turin. Townsend also scored in that game, which ended in a 1-1 tie.

Townsend said, "I have known Harry for four, five, or six years. We grew up together in the youth team. He is a fantastic talent. If you give him a chance, he always scores."

If a player plays the full 90 minutes in a match under manager Pasquale Marino, the next day at training is dedicated to recovery. However, Alexis Sanchez might find this difficult. Marino was the manager who brought Sanchez into Udinese’s first team in 2008. Sanchez had been signed from the Chilean club Cobreloa two years earlier. At that time, Udinese had Italy internationals Antonio Di Natale, Simone Pepe, and Fabio Quagliarella competing for forward positions. But Marino knew that Sanchez was a special talent. Sanchez has impressed for Arsenal this season after moving from Barcelona for £30 million.

A golden eagle interrupted a football team’s training session in North Vancouver. Although some people thought it might be a young bald eagle, it looks like a golden eagle. The bird walked up to a football, pecked it with its beak, and shook its head. Then, it used its foot to roll the ball to the left. Excited by the movement, the eagle ran after the ball, rolled it to the right, and jumped on it with both feet.

Michael Duff, 37, has been told his career was over nearly eight years ago, so he probably didn’t expect to be defending against Harry Kane at Turf Moor this weekend. Kane is currently playing very well, and Duff, a long-time Burnley defender, will need all his experience to stop him when Tottenham visits on Sunday.

Duff said, “I played against Kane when he was on loan at Millwall. He was young then, and you could see he was a good player. But I don’t think anyone could have predicted what has happened to him in the last 12 months. I don’t think it’s rude to say he has come from nowhere.”

England will send an Under 20 team to the Toulon Tournament this summer because the experiment was successful last year. Gareth Southgate’s team finished fourth last May, and many of those players will also take part in the European Under 21 Championships in June. The Football Association (FA) decided to enter the tournament again because they believe playing against a wide variety of strong opponents helps young players learn and improve. Aidy Boothroyd will coach the team in the tournament, which runs from May 27 to June 7. Last year, Gareth Southgate led England to fourth place. Liverpool winger Jordon Ibe might also be part of the squad.

Keith Curle tells stories about managing a football team that might explain why many retired players prefer working as TV commentators instead of taking management jobs. However, this is not what he wants. In fact, he enjoys the hard work. As the manager of Carlisle, he has done many difficult tasks over the years, such as fixing a broken toilet, using a hose, and paying his staff’s salaries from his own money. He says this is the life he wants because it motivates him.

Rickie Fowler, a famous golfer, has won more fans by defending his girlfriend, Alexis Randock, against an online bully. The bully, who goes by the name "fatalsplash," left a mean comment on a photo Alexis posted on Instagram. In the photo, Alexis and her sister Nicole are on the beach. The photo was seen by Alexis’s 25,000 followers, including the bully, who called Alexis a "gold digger." Fowler spoke out against this accusation, earning praise from his supporters.

Forget fancy cars or helicopters. The ultimate sign of wealth might be clothes made from gold. At a fashion show in Xi’an, China, models wore outfits made of the precious metal. These included gold underwear and a chain-mail style shirt. The outfit is worth about £40,000. It was not light. The male model’s shirt weighed 7 pounds. The female model’s matching bra and underwear also weighed 7 pounds. The style may be inspired by royal women in history.

Brendan Rodgers spoke on Thursday, but everyone was focused on one thing: Raheem Sterling’s TV interview from the day before. This interview overshadowed Liverpool’s important upcoming match against Arsenal, a team competing for a top-four spot.

In the interview, Sterling talked about his unpaid contract, which pays £100,000 a week. He also said he cares more about winning trophies than making money. Most worryingly, he admitted that he liked the attention from Arsenal, who are playing Liverpool on Saturday. Despite the controversy, Sterling looked calm during Liverpool’s training session on Thursday morning.

Everton manager Roberto Martinez says he is not worried that striker Romelu Lukaku has hired famous agent Mino Raiola, even though there might be rumors about Lukaku moving to another club this summer. Raiola is a very powerful agent who knows Italian and Dutch football well. Some of his famous players include Zlatan Ibrahimovic at Paris Saint-Germain, Paul Pogba at Juventus, and Mario Balotelli at Liverpool.

A man killed himself with a gun at Universal Studios in Hollywood, California. The incident happened around 2:15 pm on Friday. The man was standing in a smoking area behind the "Despicable Me Minion Mayhem" ride. This spot was near families and children. After the shooting, crowds ran around the park in a panic. The man’s name has not been released.

Real Madrid really wants to sign Manchester United goalkeeper David De Gea. However, reports from Spain say they are willing to wait until next summer if Louis van Gaal refuses to negotiate. De Gea has played very well this season, while Real Madrid’s current goalkeeper, Iker Casillas, is no longer seen as reliable. Although Real Madrid would like to sign De Gea this June, they are also considering signing Chelsea’s Petr Cech to cover the position until De Gea’s contract with Manchester United ends next year. The newspaper AS is focusing on the story of Real Madrid trying to sign De Gea, while the newspaper Marca is focusing on James Rodriguez.

John Carver knows very well that a match between Newcastle and Sunderland can make or break a manager’s career. He learned this lesson in August 1999, when he was assistant manager to Ruud Gullit. On a rainy night at St James' Park, Gullit made the controversial decision not to start star players Alan Shearer and Duncan Ferguson. Newcastle lost 2-1, and Gullit lost his job because of that choice.

Now, Carver is trying to keep his current job as head coach after this season ends. He knows that winning or losing this Sunday’s game against Sunderland could have a big impact on his future. He is excited to manage his hometown club against Sunderland.

Louis van Gaal says Manchester United can still win the Premier League. They are currently eight points behind the leaders, Chelsea, and have played one more game than them. Van Gaal also said that Marouane Fellaini plays so well that he is almost impossible to leave out of the team. If United beats Aston Villa on Saturday, it will put pressure on Manchester City, who are in second place. City do not play their next game until Monday against Crystal Palace.

Frank Lampard said he would love to see a gay football player come out and be fully respected by the public. He believes the sport is changing and becoming less "macho."

Lampard, who plays for Manchester City on loan, shared these views while appearing on the TV show "Alan Carr's Chatty Man." He was joined by Denise van Outen, Noel Fielding, and Lethal Bizzle. Lampard feels that football is improving.

Ryan Bertrand posted a photo on Instagram showing him and his daughter standing next to matching red Ferraris. He is 25 years old and plays as a left back for Southampton. He bought his young daughter a Ferrari just like the one he owns. The photo was taken outside their home.

Bertrand is having a great season. Since moving from Chelsea to Southampton in the summer, he has played in 26 Premier League games. His move from Chelsea started as a loan, but it became permanent in February.

Dick Advocaat promises not to repeat the mistake he made during his first season at Rangers, where he downplayed the importance of the Old Firm derby. Tomorrow, the 67-year-old manages Sunderland for the first time at home against their local rivals, Newcastle.

In 1998, Advocaat called the Old Firm match just another game. Celtic won 5-1, and fans and the media criticized him for underestimating how intense the rivalry was. Now, Advocaat insists he will not underestimate the importance of the Wear-Tyne Derby. He and his assistant, Paul Bracewell, are overseeing training ahead of this crucial match on Sunday.

Danny Cipriani helped Sale Sharks win 23-6 against Gloucester last Saturday. He scored 13 points during the game. Since Sale is no longer competing in Europe, Cipriani and his teammates have a free weekend. They used this time to rest and go on a short trip to Dubai. They are now ready for the final four important games of the Aviva Premiership.

Lexi Thompson is now 20 years old. When she was 12, she became the youngest player ever to compete in the U.S. Women’s Open. She has won six professional championships and earned nearly $3 million in her career. She will be on the cover of the May issue of Golf Digest. On the cover, she will be topless, using only a towel to cover her body.

President Richard Nixon’s large home in San Clemente, California, is now for sale for $75 million. The property, known as the "Western White House" or "La Casa Pacifica," covers 5.45 acres and overlooks the Pacific Ocean. Nixon bought the house, which was built in 1926, in 1969, just six months after he became president. During his time there, he hosted 17 world leaders.

One fan waited almost an hour just to spend five seconds with Ryan Taylor. They took a quick photo and wished him luck before Sunday’s big match against Sunderland. It is clear that Taylor is one of the few Newcastle players truly respected by fans who are unhappy with the team.

Taylor scored the winning goal at the Stadium of Light three years ago. This achievement earned him a song from the fans—"Ryan Taylor, over the wall"—and a place in the club’s history. However, the fans’ admiration for him goes beyond just that one free-kick against their rivals.

Football players have always had strange hairstyles, but Brazilian player Ratinho has gone too far with his latest look. The 35-year-old midfielder for Remo showed off his new hair during a Brazilian Cup match against Atletico PR on Thursday. He had hexagon shapes shaved into his head to make it look like a soccer ball. Remo tied the game 1-1, thanks to a goal by Igor Joao in the 76th minute.

Arsenal are feeling confident as they prepare to host Liverpool at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday afternoon. This match is part of the Champions League qualification race. Arsenal is currently third in the Premier League, six points ahead of fifth-place Liverpool. During training on Friday at London Colney, the players seemed relaxed for this important game. One photo even showed players playfully slapping defender Laurent Koscielny. Manager Arsene Wenger is likely happy because his team won all six of their matches in March, earning him the Manager of the Month award.

Neymar and his Barcelona teammate Dani Alves showed their support for the club’s basketball team by attending a game. They went to watch the match on Thursday night, along with Neymar’s sister, Rafaella. Barcelona won the Euro League game with a close score of 85-80.

Neymar took a selfie with friends and Dani Alves during the event. Even though Barcelona lost, Real Madrid is still first in their division because of the points difference.

Separately, Neymar helped Brazil beat Chile 1-0 at the Emirates Stadium on Sunday. It was a tough game, and Neymar had to deal with several hard hits from the Chilean players.

Arsene Wenger, the manager of Arsenal, does not know exactly why Alexis Sanchez chose to join Arsenal instead of Liverpool. However, he is happy that Sanchez will be playing for Arsenal rather than against them in Saturday’s match.

After Barcelona decided to let Sanchez leave, he had the choice of which club to join. After the World Cup, the 26-year-old decided to stay with Wenger. He quickly made a good impression in English football.

Wenger admits that Liverpool might have used their interest in Sanchez to get a better deal when Arsenal tried to sign Luis Suarez from Barcelona last summer.

In the next few weeks, Louis van Gaal, the current manager of Manchester United, will have lunch with Sir Alex Ferguson. On Friday, van Gaal joked that he hoped Ferguson would pay for the meal. More importantly, he wants to have real progress to discuss. Ferguson has waited a long time for good news. The team Ferguson left for David Moyes got worse, and this season’s team has only occasionally shown clear purpose under van Gaal. Van Gaal said he plans to talk about the club with Ferguson soon.

Courtney Lawes, a rugby player for Northampton Saints, is preparing for an important match against Clermont Auvergne in France. He is not planning to change his style of play, despite recent criticism.

Last month, during a major tournament final, Lawes made a hard tackle on French player Jules Plisson. This action upset the French team so much that they tried to get Lawes banned. However, the referees decided that no punishment was necessary.

Even though the officials cleared him, many people in France have called Lawes a "thug." Some people in England have also criticized him. Now, he is traveling to France carrying this negative reputation as he prepares for the upcoming quarter-final game.

Juan Mata says that England captain Wayne Rooney is very confident that England will win the Euro 2016 tournament in France. Rooney tells Mata this every day. In an interview, Mata, who was Manchester United’s best player in March, talked about Rooney’s strong belief about the upcoming tournament next June. Mata, who hasn’t played for Spain since they were eliminated in the first round of the 2014 World Cup, admitted that England is a team to watch. He also noted that Rooney recently scored his 47th goal for England in a 4-0 win against Lithuania at Wembley.

Anthony Joshua says his strong desire and focus will make up for Jason Gavern’s greater experience when they fight in Newcastle on Saturday. This will be Joshua’s first fight of 2015. He had to cancel a January match against Kevin Johnson because of a stress fracture in his back. Joshua has never lost in 10 professional fights, but he has never gone beyond the third round. Gavern, on the other hand, is making his 50th career appearance. The photo shows Joshua at the weigh-in before the fight at the Newcastle Metro Arena.

Raheem Sterling and Theo Walcott will probably play against each other at the Emirates Stadium on Saturday. They are at very different stages in their careers. Walcott, who is 26, might serve as a warning for Sterling, who is 20, showing how early talent can sometimes fail to reach its full potential. Both players are currently negotiating new contracts with their clubs. Brendan Rodgers has praised Walcott in the past, while Arsene Wenger has clearly stated that he likes Sterling. It is even possible that the two clubs might swap the players directly.

Sir Alex Ferguson, who helped develop stars like Ryan Giggs, David Beckham, and Cristiano Ronaldo, believes Neymar is the next player to challenge for the title of the world’s best. He says Neymar will compete with Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. However, Ferguson thinks the 23-year-old Neymar is not quite there yet. Neymar has been a star since moving from Santos to Barcelona two years ago, but he still has a long way to go to reach the level of Messi and Ronaldo.

Spain’s manager, Vicente del Bosque, was shocked that his team, which had many famous players, could not score any goals. They lost a friendly match against Holland on Tuesday night. Even though Spain controlled the game for large parts of it, Holland won because Stefan de Vrij and Davy Klaassen scored. The stadium was the Amsterdam ArenA. Del Bosque was most upset because Spain did not stay calm enough to score when they had the chance. De Vrij scored first by heading the ball after Wesley Sneijder passed it to him. Four minutes later, Klaassen scored again. He kicked the ball into the net after it bounced off the ground, following a save by Spain’s goalkeeper, David de Gea.

An 18-year-old inmate at the Lower Buckeye Jail in Phoenix attacked two officers, leaving one of them in intensive care with brain bleeding and broken facial bones. The incident happened in a psychiatric ward. Surveillance video shows the young man, who was booked into the jail two weeks ago, walking in a room he was not allowed to enter. Two officers told him to return to his cell, but he started hitting them. Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio confirmed the attack.

Former Marseille manager Jose Anigo says Zlatan Ibrahimovic would have been a huge star at the Stade Velodrome if he had followed in Eric Cantona’s footsteps. This is the second time in a few days that Ibrahimovic has been compared to Cantona, after Peter Schmeichel made similar comments. Schmeichel suggested that Manchester United should sign the 33-year-old Swedish player this summer. He believes Ibrahimovic has the strong personality needed to become a legend at Old Trafford, just like Cantona and David Beckham.

People say that eating slowly helps you enjoy the taste and texture of food. But Cooper, a Labrador dog, doesn’t care about that. A new video shows his reaction to getting an ice cream.

Katie Gallegos, who lives in Clackamas County, Oregon, took Cooper and her other dog, Daisy, to a McDonald’s drive-thru for ice cream. While the small female dog, Daisy, took her time and ate politely, Cooper ate the entire cone in one bite.

Katie runs a place called Dogpatch Resort. She says Cooper always eats very fast. Because of this, she always lets Daisy finish her ice cream first before giving Cooper his.

The video of Cooper eating his ice cream has been watched more than seven million times.

Cape Verde beat Portugal 2-0, which was the biggest surprise in international soccer this week. But who is Cape Verde, and how did this small island group off the west coast of Africa become a strong soccer team?

Cape Verde is an archipelago located 400 miles from Senegal. It has about 500,000 people. The islands are known for their beautiful beaches and dramatic volcanic scenery, which makes them a popular tourist destination.

Despite its small size, Cape Verde has a surprising soccer history.

A spring-breaker in Florida screamed for help because she was scared of a manatee. The manatee is a large, gentle animal that eats plants. The swimmer was in the water when a manatee floated by just inches away. Someone filmed the incident using a selfie stick. The video shows the girl’s frightened face as she treads water and looks around for the animal. She was heard screaming in terror as the harmless creature came closer.

A man named Xu, who lives near Yancheng in eastern China, was arrested for human trafficking. He bought a woman to be his son’s wife because he desperately wanted a grandchild. His son has learning difficulties.

After finding out that his son had never slept with the woman, Xu tried to get her pregnant himself. When he realized she could not have children, he sold her to another family. He is now in police custody in Lianyungang, a city in eastern China.

Even though there are many rumors about his future at Manchester United, Radamel Falcao does not seem worried. He has not been able to play regularly for the team and has admitted that he cried because he wasn’t getting enough playing time. However, he seemed to be handling things better after the international break. On Thursday, he went out for dinner in Alderley Edge with a friend and then picked up his £100,000 Porsche Panamera from a Waitrose car park. Falcao plans to decide whether to stay at Manchester United at the end of this season.

Cardiff City fans will not be at Saturday’s Championship match against Leeds United at Elland Road. The Cardiff club gave their 500 away tickets back to support their fans, who are boycotting the trip as a matter of principle.

Both clubs have a history of fan trouble. Usually, Leeds offers more than 2,500 tickets to away fans. It is not clear who decided on the low number of 500 tickets—the club, the local council, or the police.

Derek Lawrenson from Sportsmail shares his predictions for the 79th Masters golf tournament at Augusta, which starts on Thursday.

For the best American player, he suggests Dustin Johnson. Although there are many good choices, Augusta often rewards players who are trying to redeem themselves after past failures. For example, Vijay Singh and Adam Scott both won after previous disappointments. Lawrenson believes it is time for Johnson, who used to party heavily, to prove he can use his powerful long drives along with smart strategy. Stephen John Docherty, 66, has admitted to using a metal hook to severely injure a man’s scrotum because he was unhappy with the quality of a concrete job. According to NZ media, Docherty pleaded guilty to wounding with intent when he appeared at the Whakatane District Court on Wednesday. Police stated that Docherty had hired the victim to do concrete work at his property. On March 17 at around 3:30 pm, Docherty became angry when he returned home and found that the work did not meet his standards.

Simba, a cat, was rescued after being trapped under a bathtub for 27 days. Firefighters in Meckenheim, near Bonn, Germany, saved her after a neighbor heard scratching sounds in her newly renovated bathroom.

Owners Helga and Eberhard Henkel had lost Simba in early March and searched everywhere, even putting up notices in nearby streets. It is believed the cat crawled under the floorboards during the bathroom renovation. Although the owners had been looking for her for nearly four weeks, a neighbor finally raised the alarm after hearing noises coming from under the bath.

Santiago Vergini says he might stay at Sunderland if the team avoids being relegated from the Premier League. If they do, he could sign a permanent two-year contract. The 26-year-old player from Argentina came to Sunderland last August on a one-year loan from a Costa Rican team called Sport Uruguay de Coronado. He has played in 35 games this season. His most recent game was starting in Sunday’s 1-0 win against Newcastle, which greatly improved Sunderland’s chances of staying in the top league. Vergini wants to remain at Sunderland because he played an important part in that victory over Newcastle United.

Aritz Aduriz, who used to play for Valencia, scored a goal in the 90th minute to tie the game 1-1. He played for Athletic Bilbao in this match against his old team at San Mames Stadium.

Valencia had taken the lead thanks to substitute Rodrigo De Paul. However, Valencia’s player Nicolas Otamendi was sent off with a red card eight minutes earlier for a dangerous tackle. With only 10 players, Valencia could not keep the lead, and Aduriz’s late goal ensured a draw for Athletic Bilbao.

Raccoons are great climbers, but one had a problem this week. On Tuesday morning, people found a raccoon stuck 30 feet up on a flagpole outside the Cathedral Basilica of Saints Peter and Paul in Philadelphia. Videos show the animal holding on tightly while balancing on the pole.

On Wednesday night, 21-year-old rapper Keaway Lafonz Ivy, known as Kealo, was killed in Seat Pleasant, Maryland. He died from a single gunshot wound to the chest while filming a music video. Police say the shooting happened when someone in his group accidentally fired a gun that was being used as a prop. The incident occurred near 62nd Place and Eastern Avenue. On Friday, police arrested 21-year-old Lafonzo Leonard Iracks and charged him with the crime.

MI5 has issued a warning about the danger of dishonest employees in Britain’s nuclear, transport, and public services. This alert came after Andreas Lubitz, a pilot who committed suicide, crashed a plane in the Alps and killed 150 people.

Security experts are very concerned. One source said that no matter how strong physical security is, if a worker is already inside, there is nothing that can stop them from causing sabotage or terrorism.

MI5 is now advising organizations on how to handle the risk from thousands of employees who work in sensitive areas. These workers are known as “insiders,” and the Germanwings disaster highlighted this specific danger.

A 38-year-old man was hospitalized after swallowing a beer bottle at a family gathering. The incident happened in Wagaman, northern Darwin, around 9 pm on Wednesday. According to reports, the man chewed up the entire glass bottle and then went to lie down. His family called the Royal Darwin Hospital, and paramedics from St John were sent to his home. Police Superintendent Louise Jorgensen said that such drunk and foolish behavior is very frustrating for the police.

Italian officials said that on Saturday, the Italian navy and coast guard rescued about 1,500 migrants in less than 24 hours. The coast guard helped five boats in the southern Mediterranean and saved everyone on board. These rescues happened as new numbers showed that 43 percent more migrants arrived in the EU through Italy compared to the same time last year. The rescued migrants arrived at the port of Lampedusa on an Italian coast guard boat after being saved near Sicily. The 1,500 people were saved during five separate operations by two coast guard ships and one navy ship.
